mentions.name: Ato
mentions.description: An iOS app that tracks all of a user's past walks and bike rides (synced from HealthKit) and visualizes them on a single map, using a hex grid instead of routes. It adds co-op, competition, and ranking elements so a small user base can semi-compete with each other, plus options for manual check-ins and tracking through photo locations. It has no live tracking capability, deliberately avoiding battery/accuracy tradeoffs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a little app (Ato on AppStore - https://apps.apple.com/app/ato/id6757285141) for basically tracking all walks/bike rides I’ve ever been and visualize it on a single map.
